assessment.answer: The score of 0.636 is driven by a large annualized net loss (-$1,508M, -12.6% of assets), negative operating income and operating cash flow, falling revenue and liabilities at 88% of assets, all near the worst of 147 peers. The filings show distress that is worse than the band suggests. Management has substantial going concern doubt, the company missed a $79.1M guarantee deadline that lets PortoCem debenture holders declare early maturity, which can trigger cross-acceleration, it expects to breach its Q3 2025 bank covenants, its revolver is fully drawn, its debt has a fair value of about 64% of carrying value, and it has hired a financial advisor to review strategic alternatives. The score reflects real distress, and if anything it understates the risk.
moved_by: Missed the August 17, 2025 deadline for the $79,100K PortoCem bank guarantee, so a majority of holders can declare early maturity, and cross-acceleration clauses can pull in other debt
Company states it would not have sufficient liquidity to repay principal if substantially all debt is accelerated
Expected non-compliance with first lien and fixed charge coverage covenants for the quarter ending September 30, 2025, after needing a covenant holiday for Q2 2025
Revolving Facility fully utilized ($729,933K) and TLA commitments cut to zero, so there is no undrawn committed liquidity
Letter of Credit Facility now matures November 14, 2025 with shrinking commitments and a possible 102% cash collateral requirement
Retained a financial advisor and started a strategic alternatives process
Fair value of debt of $5,785M versus $9,087,890K fair value at year-end 2024, a deep market discount that signals creditor concern
Q2 2025 operating cash burn of about $352M in one quarter leaves about 5 months of unrestricted cash
Springing maturities in mid-2026 on $2.73B New 2029 Notes, the Revolver and Term Loans unless the $510.9M 2026 Notes are retired, while prepayment of the 2026 Notes is restricted
Missed GMLP preferred dividend on May 15, 2025, two missed or late PortoCem guarantee deadlines, and repeated late filings with Nasdaq notices

reasons.quote: In the first and second quarters of 2025, the Company recognized operating losses and negative operating cash flows, and this decline in earnings accelerated in the second quarter of 2025.

reasons.reason: Months of cash: unrestricted cash is $551.1M. The six-month burn of $384.2M (about $64M a month) gives about 8.6 months. The Q2 burn of about $352.5M (six-month -$384.2M less Q1 -$31.7M, about $117M a month) gives about 4.7 months. Including restricted cash ($821.4M total, partly limited to Brazil construction), the range is about 7 to 13 months. This comes before about $271M of unfinanced committed capex.
